_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Egypt covering Predynastic Nile Valley, Old-Middle-New Kingdoms, Ptolemaic dynasty, Roman/Byzantine/Islamic eras, Ottoman period, Muhammad Ali dynasty, British occupation, Nasser pan-Arabism, Sadat peace, Mubarak authoritarianism, and 2011 revolution.

ethnic_groups.name: Egyptian Arab
ethnic_groups.notes: Arabic-speaking majority; descended from ancient Egyptians with Arab cultural overlay post-7th century

ethnic_groups.name: Coptic
ethnic_groups.notes: Egyptian Christians preserving pre-Islamic heritage; Coptic Orthodox Church; concentrated in Upper Egypt and Cairo

ethnic_groups.name: Nubian
ethnic_groups.notes: Southern Egypt (Aswan); displaced by Aswan High Dam; distinct Nubian languages; related to Sudanese Nubians

ethnic_groups.name: Bedouin
ethnic_groups.notes: Sinai Peninsula and Eastern/Western Desert tribes; nomadic and semi-nomadic; include Ma'aza, Ababda, Haweitat

ethnic_groups.name: Berber (Siwi)
ethnic_groups.notes: Siwa Oasis; only remaining Berber-speaking community in Egypt; Siwi language

ethnic_groups.name: Beja
ethnic_groups.notes: Southeastern Egypt; Red Sea Hills; Cushitic-speaking pastoralists

independence.notes: Full sovereignty effectively 1952 with Free Officers Revolution

natural_resources.notes: Suez Canal revenues ($9.4B/yr, vital global trade artery, 12% of world trade transits); Zohr gas field (Mediterranean, largest in region); declining oil but growing gas; Nile River (lifeblood, 97% of pop lives on 5% of land along Nile); tourism (pyramids, Luxor) ~12% GDP pre-COVID; Aswan High Dam hydropower

military.notes: Largest military in Africa/Middle East by personnel; $1.3B US military aid annually (Camp David Accords legacy); military controls ~25-40% of economy (construction, food, manufacturing); Sisi consolidated military power; Sinai counterinsurgency vs ISIS affiliate (Wilayat Sinai)

infrastructure.notes: Suez Canal landing point for 16+ submarine cables; critical internet transit hub.

debt_aid.notes: IMF $3B Extended Fund Facility (2022); massive Gulf investment (Ras El-Hekma deal $35B from UAE, 2024); currency devaluation 50%+ since 2022; external debt ~$165B; New Administrative Capital $58B megaproject

top_universities: Al-Azhar University (970 CE, world's oldest degree-granting)
education.notes: Al-Azhar world's oldest functioning university; massive student population (~3M in higher education); rote learning culture criticized; Japanese-Egyptian schools experiment; STEM schools (Nile University); private university expansion

diaspora_migration.diaspora_population: 12 million (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Jordan, USA, Italy, UK)
diaspora_migration.notes: Remittances critical ($32B, ~7.5% GDP); Gulf states primary destination; Sudanese refugees ~4M since 2023 war; Syrian refugees ~130k; Egyptian migration pattern: Gulf for income, Europe for settlement; brain drain in medicine/engineering

digital_economy.notes: Largest tech ecosystem in Africa/MENA by some measures; Fawry (payments) first Egyptian tech unicorn; Swvl, Halan, MNT-Halan; government digitization push; Telecom Egypt fiber backbone improving; Knowledge City in New Capital; fintech leading sector

country_profile.notes_unique: Home to one of the world's oldest civilisations (c. 3100 BCE); the Great Pyramid of Giza was the tallest man-made structure for over 3,800 years; the Suez Canal handles ~12% of world trade.
country_profile.national_anthem: Bilady, Bilady, Bilady (My Country, My Country, My Country)

geography.terrain: Vast desert plateau; Nile River valley and delta; Sinai Peninsula; Western and Eastern deserts
geography.notes: 96% desert; 95%+ population lives in Nile Valley/Delta (5% of land); Suez Canal connects Mediterranean-Red Sea; Pyramids of Giza; New Administrative Capital under construction.

economy_extended.notes: 3rd largest African economy; Suez Canal revenue (~$8B/yr); Ras el-Hekma mega-deal with UAE ($35B, 2024); severe currency devaluation; Zohr gas field; remittances ~$22B.

health.notes: Universal Health Insurance Law (2018) rolling out; hepatitis C elimination campaign (world's largest); high obesity rates; NCD epidemic.

food_agriculture.notes: World's largest wheat importer; all agriculture irrigated (Nile); new 1.5M feddan reclamation; food subsidy system for 70M people.

energy.notes: Zohr gas field (Mediterranean, largest in region); Benban Solar Park (1.8GW, world's largest); El Dabaa nuclear plant (Rosatom, under construction); surplus electricity capacity.

transport.notes: Suez Canal handles 12-15% of global trade; Cairo Metro (oldest in Africa/Middle East); new high-speed rail (Siemens); New Administrative Capital Monorail.

tourism.notes: One of world's top tourist destinations; Grand Egyptian Museum (2024, world's largest archaeological museum); Red Sea resorts; Nile cruises.

human_rights_gender.notes: FGM very high despite 2008 ban; mass political prisoners since 2013; NGO restrictions; women underrepresented in workforce.

security_stability.notes: Sinai counterinsurgency against Wilayat Sinai (IS affiliate); one of world's top arms importers; mediator in Israel-Palestine; GERD dispute with Ethiopia.

cultural_heritage.national_dish: Koshari (lentils, rice, pasta, chickpeas, tomato sauce)
cultural_heritage.film_industry: Hollywood of the Arab world (Egyptian cinema since 1920s; 4000+ films)
cultural_heritage.media_landscape: Largest Arabic media industry; Al-Ahram; state and private broadcasters; heavily restricted post-2013
cultural_heritage.notes: Cradle of civilization (5000+ years); Arabic language and culture centerpiece; Al-Azhar University (world's oldest degree-granting, 970 CE).

legal_system.legal_tradition: Mixed: civil law (Napoleonic Code influenced), Islamic law
legal_system.sharia_applicability: Main source of legislation (Article 2); personal status law
legal_system.notes: Exceptional military courts try civilians; emergency provisions; reformed investment laws; Al-Azhar advisory role on Islamic law.

comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global.
comparative_rankings.notes: Africa's most populous Arab nation and 3rd largest economy.
